pages.text: Restore a quarry corpse’s core, or one recovered from a Forgotten Miner, through $(l:world/mine_recovery)mine recovery$(). This profession has no crafting recipe. Its purple-framed mining-core crest and weathered head insignia distinguish it from an ordinary miner.

It prioritizes Forge-tagged ores in its active quarry layer and spends half the normal stamina on movement, mining, draining, and reinforcement. The bonus neither exposes distant deposits nor skips layers. Detection Range still limits reach and travel.

Use the ordinary $(l:companions/mining)Mining Slime$() controls: pickaxe, shovel, bag, Mine order, bucket, and wall supplies. Transport and Warehouse Slimes unload it and supply tools, buckets, and cobblestone. Shared stairs remain protected. Recovery, portals, and first release select Wait.
